name: Nextcloud Desktop Client
description: macOS is genuine A (Sparkle pinned EdDSA), but the Windows NSISUpdater downloads the MSI and runs it via msiexec with zero hash/signature. Linux notify-only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Nextcloud’s macOS application template embeds a Sparkle EdDSA public key and integrates the framework’s updater. Windows and Linux verification policies and shipped artifacts remain separate, unresolved evidence requirements.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot; released artifact signatures, framework internals, generated feeds, and Linux-specific updater behavior were not independently audited.
